thread:
nina_sales: ACME POC hit a blocker during demo. Clients seeing 403 + 'invalid_project_claim' when calling embeddings. They say key is active in console. Can eng triage?

devx_ian: Paste their exact request and error. Also any request_id from logs helps.

nina_sales: They sent this: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_trial_7a8b' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Org: acme-eu' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Project: demo-alpha' \
  -d '{"model":"rw/emb-small","input":"hello"}'```
Response: `{\"error\":\"invalid_project_claim\",\"status\":403,\"hint\":\"token project=demo-prod != header demo-alpha\"}`

sam_eng: That hint means the JWT claim project is demo-prod but header says demo-alpha. Likely they copied an old project key or their CI injected a different key.

nina_sales: Customer says they used the console key from project page. Could be multiple keys.

devx_ian: Easiest fix: rotate/create a new project-scoped key in Console -> Projects -> demo-alpha -> Keys -> Create, then update apps. Quick workaround: remove X-Redwood-Project header so server falls back to token claim, but not ideal for multi-project flows.

ops_lee: Note: we rolled enforcement yesterday to block mismatched project headers. Old global keys will 403 now. If they can't rotate, we can add a temporary routing exception for their tenant_id but that requires change control and will take hours.

nina_sales: They also reported brief 429s earlier. Could be they retried a bunch of requests during the demo. Any quick quota bump we can grant?

sam_eng: For short-term demo, ops can bump burst to 80 and steady to 6rps on the project. But warn them to back off retries or enable exponential backoff.

devx_ian: Ask them to decode the JWT (header+payload only) and paste the payload here (redact signature). We just need the claims to confirm project/org. Or they can give us request_id and we decode server-side.

nina_sales: Request_id from their log: req-2026-09-acme-601. I've opened support ticket.

support_bot: support-bot: ticket #SUP-2026-489 created for request_id=req-2026-09-acme-601, assigned eng-triage.

ops_lee: I'll prepare a 48h quota bump and document it. If they need sustained throughput, we should pitch a Dedicated trial. Nina, want me to pre-draft the trial terms?

nina_sales: Yes please, ops. For now I'm asking the customer to rotate the key and hold off on replays. I'll paste the new curl when they update. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

sam_eng: If rotation fails, they can paste the JWT payload (no signature) and we'll decode. If we need to escalate to infra for routing exception, tag me.

nina_sales: Following up with the customer now and will update ticket.
